findings.summary: The Fish completion script breaks because format_completion now emits three newline-separated lines per item, but Fish splits command substitution on newlines and iterates single lines, so metadata parsing fails and completion is broken for every command.

judge.reason: Same defect: newline-separated fields get split by fish command substitution, breaking metadata parsing.

findings.summary: Escaping newlines as a literal \n is lossy (indistinguishable from a literal backslash-n) and Fish does not unescape it, so users see a literal \n in descriptions; replacing newlines with a space would be better.

judge.reason: Escaping newlines as literal \n is lossy and displays literally in fish; a real, if minor, defect distinct from b1.

findings.summary: The Fish script compares against "_" as the no-help sentinel, so a real help string that is exactly "_" is indistinguishable from no help.

judge.reason: A help string of exactly "_" is indistinguishable from the no-help sentinel; a real but minor edge case, not b1.
